brief1.title: 明明写了“不覆盖”，为什么文件还是被替换了？
brief1.proposition: A restriction retained in a request does not enforce itself in the file operation.
brief1.synopsis: In isolated real-component tests, write refused overwrite while copy and move replaced the destination despite the same false flag. Public-ingress applicability remains unverified.
brief1.causalScene: A marked destination folder retains its small non-replacement emblem while an incoming amber document visibly displaces the existing blue document.
brief1.titlePromise: Make the difference between a recorded restriction and an actual replacement visible.
brief1.readerProblem: A restriction can survive in the record yet fail to constrain the last operation.
brief1.dominantSubject: One recognizable cobalt optical-glass file folder with a titanium rim
brief1.singleAction: An amber document slides into the folder, displacing the original blue sheet
brief1.visibleResult: The folder still carries its etched non-replacement emblem while its contents have changed
anchors: restriction emblem remaining on the folder
brief1.composition: Landscape 16:9. One grouped subject across 62% width and 46% height, centered slightly below midpoint; open space above and below. Upright folder, oblique incoming sheet, shallow reflecting foreground, softly blurred ivory stone arches behind.
brief1.materialLighting: Cobalt optical glass, brushed titanium, restrained amber glass, warm ivory architectural studio, soft directional light, crisp refraction and realistic contact shadows.
brief1.sanitizedPrompt: Create a premium editorial 3D technology illustration, wide landscape 16:9. In a luminous ivory stone architectural studio with softly blurred tall arches and a continuous pale reflective floor, one recognizable open file folder is made from deep cobalt-blue optical glass with a precise brushed-titanium rim. A small elegant silver emblem engraved on its front depicts two overlapping page outlines crossed by one short diagonal stroke. The emblem stays crisp and intact. A luminous amber-glass document is sliding diagonally down into this same folder, visibly pushing the original cobalt-blue document sideways out of the folder. The original sheet has three broad cobalt inset content lines; the incoming sheet has three broad amber inset content lines. This one compact interaction is the entire visual subject. Folder and two sheets form a clear readable silhouette, balanced across about 62 percent of the canvas width and 46 percent of its height, centered slightly below the midpoint. The top 26 percent and bottom 20 percent remain spacious ivory atmosphere and gently reflective floor. Sophisticated tactile glass, subtle metal bevels, realistic refraction, soft warm directional illumination, fine contact shadows, restrained amber highlights, high-end editorial product photography finish. Visual communication through objects, material and action.

brief2.articleTitle: 检查通过，为什么还不能立刻放心？
brief2.coreProposition: 检查描述的是当时的内容，不能阻止随后被使用的对象变化。
brief2.synopsis: E4 在检查前改变源被拒绝；E5 在检查后由研究代码注入变化，真实复制执行器使用了新字节。不是生产竞态复现。
brief2.causalScene: 放大镜保留原始直线内容，笔正在改变同一页的内容。
brief2.titlePromise: 说明检查到动作之间仍有事实变化的空间
brief2.readerProblem: 把检查通过误当成事实永远保持
brief2.singleAction: 琥珀笔改写已被观察的内容
brief2.visibleResult: 透镜内旧直线与文件上新弯线并存
brief2.composition: 主体宽65%、高48%，中间略偏下，上下留白
brief2.sanitizedPrompt: Create a premium editorial 3D technology illustration in a wide 16:9 landscape. A recognizable cobalt-blue optical-glass document rests at a shallow angle above a continuous ivory stone floor. Its face has three broad inset content lines. A brushed-titanium magnifying glass, positioned to the left, reveals a small crisp cobalt-blue miniature of the document's original three straight lines within its lens. On the right, one elegant amber-glass fountain pen touches the main document, changing its lowest content line into a clearly different amber curved line, with a tiny luminous amber contact point. The lens retains the original blue straight-line pattern while the page visibly acquires the changed amber mark. One page, one act of editing, and one retained earlier view form a single cohesive scene. The whole arrangement occupies about 65 percent of canvas width and 48 percent of height, centered slightly below the midpoint, with spacious upper and lower ivory margins. Low horizontal composition, recognizable everyday objects with exquisite optical-glass and titanium craftsmanship. Softly blurred warm ivory architectural arches recede into the background. Gentle reflections, realistic refraction, soft contact shadows, restrained cobalt and amber light, refined cinematic editorial product photography.
